decision_conditions: <p class="MsoNormal"><u><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Sustainable Drainage</span></u><span style="font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;- The development approved by this permission shall not be occupied until the scheme for the provision of surface water drainage has been implemented in accordance with the details submitted to the local planning authority with this application.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"></p><p class="MsoNormal"><u><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 11pt;">: To ensure satisfactory means of surface water drainage, to reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Construction Vehicles</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not commence until details
of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction
vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process
have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp; The approved details must be
implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process and shall include a requirement that there will be no</span></span><span style="font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;construction deliveries during peak hours
07.00 – 09.00 and 16.00 – 19.00.</span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Highways licenses must be applied for.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>
